facts.statement: The researchers created a 3D-printed hydrogel system designed to release stem cell-derived vesicles slowly at the site of brain injury.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: The study used an animal model of traumatic brain injury to test the treatment's effects on behavior, cell growth, and molecular pathways.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Animals treated with the 3D-printed vesicle gel showed better long-term coordination and memory and less brain tissue damage than untreated animals.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The treatment caused more cells to grow and develop into brain cell types like neurons and support cells within the injured area.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The study found that the treatment worked by activating a specific chain of molecular signals inside stem cells that drives new brain cell formation.
